backend_fixture_shape.now: fixed RFC3339 UTC timestamp passed to VerifyWork
backend_fixture_shape.payload_canonical: exact decoded payload_b64 bytes as a JSON string
backend_fixture_shape.platform_public_key: unpadded base64url public key for seed 0x24 repeated 32 times
backend_fixture_shape.runner_version: eligible semantic version passed to VerifyWork (e.g. 0.3.0)
backend_fixture_shape.token: compact EdDSA aim-scan-spec+jwt JWS, header kid=census-platform-test-24

backend_requirements: Backend emits top-level backend_fixture_shape with variant probe or scan in the token; exact 16.1 schema with only scan_mode, binding_method and planned_processed_bytes added to v1. The gateway never regenerates backend files. Consumer skips only missing files and rejects re-signed v1 census, unknown field, or each of content_read_budget_bytes/archive_allowance_bytes/archive_caps/pattern_versions.
cloudflare_contract: Same fixture shape, public test keys and preimage fields as AWS; R2 connector_type/version stay r2_verifier/r2_verifier-v1, v2 eligibility starts at 0.2.0. Each receipt embeds its signed R2 spec.
description: Runbooks 16.1 / 18 AWS census wire proof. Gateway receipts are generated by real Scan/report/terminal/signReceipt; backend specs are consumed unchanged. Fixed keys are public test material only.
preflight_contract: Seed-budget files contain census_preflight from real probe encoders for 60 AWS / 45 Cloudflare ZIPs, with 10000 stored 1-KiB entries in the zero-seed exclusion selected by the later scan seed. Request-limit cases cover 1023999/1024000 GETs and memory-only/both-bound refusals. Band is absent only on request overflow, never a string over_bound.
receipt_fixture_shape: {description, spec: <backend_fixture_shape>, variant: scan|terminal, receipt: <signed document including receipt_signature>, signature_valid: boolean}. spec is the exact signed v2 scan answered by this receipt. Tampered is the complete receipt with only content_census.depth_class changed after signing.
